VI.description: Returns the identifier of the calling process - LabVIEW itself - through kernel32.dll GetCurrentProcessId (stdcall\2C called in any thread). Compare it with user32 GetWindowThreadProcessId.vi to tell LabVIEW's own windows from everybody else's. When error in carries an error the DLL is not called. Generated by scripts\5CBuild Win32 Wrappers.vi - do not edit by hand\2C rebuild it.

Control.description: When this carries an error the DLL is not called and the error is passed to error out.
